name: @promopilot/schema-validator
description: Validate schema.org JSON-LD from the command line: JSON syntax, @context, required and recommended properties for Google rich result types (Product, Offer, Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, Organization, LocalBusiness, Event, Recipe, VideoObject, JobPosting…), ISO dates and durations, prices, currencies and URLs. Zero-dependency Node.js CLI, library and GitHub Action. Free online version by PromoPilot.
author: Alexandr Krikun (https://github.com/ksanyok)
